entities.summary: Ząbkowice Śląskie is a town in Lower Silesian Voivodeship, in south-western Poland. It is the seat of Ząbkowice County and of a local municipality called Gmina Ząbkowice Śląskie. The town lies approximately 63 kilometres south of the regional capital Wrocław. As of 2019, it had a population of 15,004.
